opened: Opened in {{agent}} in a separate window behind your browser: if it asks for permission or an answer, find it on the taskbar.
backgroundFailed: Could not start it in the background.
requestSaved: Request saved: your agent will see it in your next session.
titleAgent: Opens your agent ({{agent}}) in a separate window with the command already written: there you see what it does and approve it.
titlePortal: The agent ({{agent}}) does it without opening any window: its progress and conversation are shown in the notice at the bottom right.
startedPortal: Started with {{agent}}: its progress is shown in the notice at the bottom right.
titleCopy: Your agent cannot be opened from here: the command is shown so you can paste it into it.
terminalHint: Opens behind your browser; you answer and approve in that window.
backgroundHint: No window and only with the app's tools. It is followed in the portal notice.
laterHint: Your agent will see it when you press “Handle requests”, on the Agent page.

ready.watching: A notice will appear here as soon as it is ready.

cantOpen: Your agent cannot be opened from here
noAgent: You do not have any AI agent installed
pasteWhere: Copy this command and paste it into your agent, in the window where you use it, opened in the CandidatAI folder.
